subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Which remaining #87711 subproblem should be canonical for next work: reset binding durability/self-heal, Telegram no-text delivery diagnostics, progress heartbeat, or reset/warm-start UX?
rationale: The strongest current evidence points to a reset/session durability invariant, but the issue also requests new channel diagnostics and UX surfaces that should not be bundled into one automated repair without maintainer scope.

options.title: Prioritize Reset Durability
options.body: Treat the store/transcript invariant and missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical fix, then split visible Telegram diagnostics and UX asks into follow-up issues.

options.title: Split The Umbrella First
options.body: Keep this issue as tracking only and require maintainers to designate separate canonical issues before implementation starts.

options.title: Prioritize Visible Telegram Recovery
options.body: Fix the user-visible fallback or heartbeat first while leaving the lower-level phantom-binding invariant as separate work.

recommendation.title: Prioritize Reset Durability
recommendation.body: Treat the store/transcript invariant and missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical fix, then split visible Telegram diagnostics and UX asks into follow-up issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The recommended first slice is the reset transcript lifecycle invariant, where this history has the clearest ownership signal.
